dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains the original raw data derived from characterization of a new gold complex with a covalently attached coumarin chromophore. Furthermore, spectroscopic measurements carried out for photocatalytic trials and mechanistic studies are also included.

publicationCitation.value: L. Capulín Flores, J. J. van der Wal, and J. E. M. N. Klein, “Photosensitizing Au(I) Catalysis With Coumarins.” Chemistry – A European Journal (2026): e71185. https://doi.org/10.1002/chem.71185
